name: 🏰 Medieval Life [BECOME KING 👑]
desc:
👑・Start as NOTHING… rise to rule the entire Kingdom.

🌾・Live the harsh life of a Peasant and earn Gold to survive.
⚒️・Work jobs, build your wealth, and climb the social ladder.
⚔️・Unlock powerful roles like Knight, Priest, and Plague Doctor.
📯・Gain the Monarch’s trust… or plot against them.
👑・Take the throne and rule as King or Queen.
🔥・Rule badly… and your own people will REVOLT and steal your crown.

⚔️・11 Roles to unlock: Peasant → Villager → Servant → Jester → Priest → Plague Doctor → Sorcerer → Knight → Noble → Monarch

🏰・Will you rule the kingdom… or destroy it?

📜・OPEN BETA, expect bugs & upcoming updates!
Inspired by Rise to Royalty & Generic Roleplay Gaem
